items.title: Angus Taylor promises permanent tax cuts and to reinstate all negative gearing
items.description: The Coalition would repeal all of Labor's negative gearing and capital gains changes and spend $22.5 billion over four years handing back tax "bracket creep" to workers if elected.

items.title: Finally, a tax fight that actually means something
items.description: Labor and the Liberals are offering imperfect but undeniably bold alternative visions for the tax system. It's nice to have something to talk about.

items.title: Taylor's bold budget reply a mix of sound and dubious policy commitments
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor commits to phasing in income tax indexation under a "tax back guarantee" that he says "will fully protect all taxpayers from inflation".

items.title: Chinese Australians say Coalition pitch to cut non-citizens' welfare 'sounds like One Nation'
items.description: Chinese Australians have lashed the Coalition's plan to block non-citizens from accessing welfare services, likening the opposition's targeting of migrants to One Nation.

items.title: Trust tax could hurt young, not just ultra-wealthy, tax advisors warn
items.description: The federal budget includes a new 30 per cent minimum tax on discretionary trusts. Experts say it is not just the ultra-wealthy that will be hit.

items.title: Breaking: Delta Goodrem makes it to the Eurovision grand final
items.description: Delta Goodrem has performed her pop ballad Eclipse at Eurovision in Vienna, the 11th time Australia has appeared in the musical extravaganza.

items.title: Live: Hantavirus cruise ship passengers in 'good shape' ahead of arrival in Perth
items.description: Health Minister Mark Butler says the group Australia repatriated from the hantavirus cruise ship are in "good shape" ahead of their arrival in Perth today. Follow live.

items.title: The Liberals said John was dead, but he's considering a new political life
items.description: When John Ternel quit the Victorian Liberal Party this week the party mistakenly sent an email to members saying he had died. Mr Ternel says the ordeal confirmed to him that the Victorian Liberals are in shambles.

items.title: The food, music and praise served up at the Trump-Xi state banquet
items.description: Guests dined on Beijing roast duck and tiramisu while the People's Liberation Army band performed some classic hits.

items.title: Sam Kerr to leave Chelsea after six years at London club
items.description: The Matildas star has spent over six years playing for the London-based team.

items.title: Shed weight, go slow and pump up your tyres to save on fuel
items.description: How to reduce your petrol bill by changing your driving technique and tinkering with your car.

items.title: How the wisdom of experience won the State of Origin series for New South Wales
items.description: New South Wales series win over Queensland proves that sometimes, like anything else, practice makes perfect in State of Origin football.

items.title: Ambulance data shows overdose callout at Crown Melbourne every two weeks
items.description: Paramedics have attended more than 50 suspected overdoses at Crown Melbourne in the past two years, with the casino complex averaging an ambulance call-out for a suspected overdose every two weeks, data released exclusively to the ABC shows.

items.title: Seven dead, scores missing in Kyiv as Russia continues onslaught
items.description: Russia launches hundreds of drones at Ukraine in the third straight day of widespread attacks on targets across the country.

items.title: It's been 20 years since the wrong Guy was interviewed by the BBC
items.description: Guy Gomo reflects on his infamous live TV mix-up, which has been immortalised as one of the greatest TV blunders of all time.

items.title: Sensory-friendly show breaks 'theatre etiquette' to make audience feel safer
items.description: The State Theatre Company South Australia has introduced a sensory-friendly performance for a broader range of audience members including neurodivergent people.

items.title: ABC news quiz: A Eurovision boycott, a pungent frog and a mysterious red globule
items.description: This is not the week to boycott the news quiz, when a particularly ripe frog and a big, red … something … await you.

items.title: Archaeologists restoring oldest colonial-era boat ever found in Australia
items.description: Maritime archaeologists are working to restore the oldest colonial-era boat ever found in Australia, discovered during the construction of the Barangaroo metro station in 2018.

items.title: 'Mega' gas-fired power stations could be the new normal, analyst says
items.description: Energy Australia says the proposed 1.4-gigawatt gas-fired power plant would be critical to the energy transition by supplying reliable back-up power, but analysts have flagged supply and economic issues.

items.title: Sexual abuse, a thwarted Olympic dream, and the sister who uncovered the truth
items.description: Ian Walker was one of the most promising athletes in the country until his life started to unravel, and the search for the truth in his tragic story has finally come to light.

items.title: Community decries government 'arrogance' over fracking bill
items.description: Producers on South Australia's Limestone Coast say they are stunned by a government proposal to lift the fracking ban in the region.

items.title: Leadership contenders edge towards challenging UK PM Starmer
items.description: The UK's health secretary has resigned from cabinet and another Labour MP has quit parliament paving the way for a potential leadership challenge to Prime Minister Keir Starmer.

items.title: Abandoned base's toxic waste clean-up deadline rejected
items.description: The Australian government has officially ruled out cleaning up Antarctica's contaminated Wilkes Station before the end of the decade, as previously recommended by a federal parliamentary committee.

items.title: Bus rollover on Queensland's Bruce Highway leaves one dead and many injured
items.description: Two other passengers suffered life-threatening injuries after the large coach overturned between Townsville and Bowen.

items.title: Mannagh's heavenly night leads Cats to statement win over Lions
items.description: Geelong records a 41-point win over Brisbane on the back of Shaun Mannagh's five-goal, 30-disposal performance at the Gabba.
